ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: According to reports, China will launch the world's first professional nighttime light remote sensing satellite "Luojia-1" 01 satellite at the end of 2017, and launch the "Luojia-1" 02 satellite in 2019. The "Luojia-1" 01 satellite carries a high-sensitivity nighttime light camera, whose precision will reach a ground resolution of 100 m; at night it can see all bridges with lights on over the Yangtze River, and obtain nighttime images with precision higher than that of current American satellites. As shown in Figure 4, suppose "Luojia-1" operates on a circular orbit with radius R, and after time t, turns through an angle θ. It is known that the gravitational constant is G. Which of the following statements is correct (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows Earth located near the center of a circular dashed orbit, and "Luojia-1" is running on this circular orbit. The dashed radius from the Earth's center to the satellite is marked as R. The question text gives that after time t it turns through central angle θ. Reasoning: Treat this circular motion as uniform angular motion, then angular velocity ω=θ/t. The orbital period is the time required to turn through one complete circle 2π, so T=2π/ω=2π/(θ/t)=2πt/θ. The G given in the question and the R in the figure do not need to be used for this question.

method.method_draft: 从题图读出“珞珈一号”绕地球做圆周轨道运动，轨道半径标为R；从题文读出经过时间t转过圆心角θ。把圆周运动视为匀速角运动，角速度ω=θ/t。完整一周对应角度2π，因此运行周期T=2π/ω=2πt/θ。注意题中给出的G和R在求周期这一问中不需要使用。

method.method_draft: 从图像识别轨道是半径为R的圆，卫星完整一周的路程为2πR；从题文得知时间t内转过角度θ，因此这段时间内对应的弧长为Rθ。若圆周运动速度恒定，则同一速度下时间与弧长成正比：t/T=(Rθ)/(2πR)=θ/(2π)。解得T=(2π/θ)t。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示地球在圆形轨道中心附近，卫星沿虚线圆形轨道运行，从地心到卫星的虚线半径标为R，说明轨道半径为R。根据题意，卫星经过时间t转过角度θ。完整圆周轨道的路程为2πR；转过角度θ对应的弧长为Rθ（θ按弧度计）。若卫星做匀速圆周运动，则时间与弧长成正比，所以t/T = Rθ/(2πR) = θ/(2π)。解得运行周期T = (2π/θ)t。
